title: Independence of correlated pair summands
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $a$ be a real coefficient vector indexed by $i<n$. Draw a sign vector uniformly, then form a second sign vector by independently, in each coordinate, keeping the first sign with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flipping it otherwise. Under this joint distribution, the random vectors $(a_i x_i,a_i y_i)$, for $i<n$, are mutually independent.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real coefficient vector indexed by $i<n$
